tools.name: browser_context
tools.description: Create a fresh handle for each actual agent before browsing. Default signed-in mode uses a separate persistent profile in installed Edge or Chrome, normally headless; it never borrows the person's browser or needs an extension. Normal OS SSO may sign in automatically; inspect the page rather than assume authentication or account restrictions. Private is explicit. Keep/resume preserve the exact context across frontend turns without another approval. After the human finishes an explicitly interactive sign-in, finish-sign-in closes that sign-in browser and reopens its same profile headlessly without replaying pages; inspect authentication again. Discard removes the owned profile while preserving exports; inspect cleanup resources. No implicit recreation or replay after an uncertain result.

action.description: Create generates a new contextId for this actual agent. Every other action requires its explicit existing handle. Finish-sign-in is only for an interactive sign-in context after the human finishes, never an ordinary work-context restart.

mode.description: Create only. Omit for an agent-owned persistent profile using the declared installed browser, or installed Edge then Chrome. Private is fresh in-memory state. Neither is an account-authorization boundary.

interactive.description: Signed-in create only. Set true only when the operator agreed to a visible window for genuine sign-in/security interaction. Default false. Do not automate credentials, MFA or consent; do not silently replace an existing uncertain context.

contextId.description: Required except create, where caller-supplied IDs are forbidden. Retain the exact generated handle, including private- prefix.

label.description: Create only. Required for default/signed-in create; optional for explicit private. Describe the actual agent and useful work, not an ownership principal.

tools.name: browser_command
tools.description: Run ordinary maintained Playwright CLI page argv using this agent's explicit contextId, never shell text. Call ["snapshot"] for an inline accessibility snapshot and element refs, then ["fill","e4","value"] or ["click","e4"]. Navigation may return a snapshot file path; call ["snapshot"] explicitly for inline refs instead of reading files. ["tab-list"] lists this context's tabs. Wait for an action before its dependent snapshot. ["eval","document.title"] reads inline page state. Help and session/profile/configuration/lifecycle/global overrides are refused. Literal leading-dash page data goes after an inner --. Missing sessions are never recreated. Inspect an uncertain result before retrying.

contextId.description: This actual agent's generated handle; mandatory for every command.

args.description: Maintained ordinary page argv, for example ["snapshot"] or ["fill","e4","value"]. No shell or connection options.
